diagrams.name: foreach_init
diagrams.description: Loop initializer. Runs once before the whole loop.

items.text:
item_id // The item_id of the loop start icon.
first // The variable that holds the current value of the iteration.
second // The collection to iterate over.

set iter_var "_it$item_id"
set go_var "_go$item_id"

set lines [ list \
"$iter_var = iter\($second\)" \
"try:" \
"    $first = $iter_var.next\(\)" \
"    $go_var = True" \
"except StopIteration:" \
"    $go_var = False" ]

return [ join $lines "\n" ]

diagrams.name: p.print_proc
diagrams.description: Prints a procedure to the specified file.

depth		// The base indentation level.

diagrams.name: p.generate
diagrams.description: Implements general high-level code generation logic for python.

items.text:
db // The file data.
gdb // The graphs extracted from the file data.
filename // The diagram file name.
pversion // Python version.

gen::fix_graph $gdb $g_callbacks 0
lassign [ gen::scan_file_description $db { header footer class } ] header footer class
set functions [ gen::generate_functions $db $gdb $g_callbacks 1 ]

set signature [ lindex $function 2 ]
set type [ lindex $signature 0 ]

set name [ lindex $function 1 ]
set lines [ list "The file does not have a class. " \
"Nowhere to put method '$name'." ]
error [ join $lines "" ]
